name: All The Fruits
introduction: All The Fruits is a surface and pattern design studio, focusing on interior design, architecture and fashion. Founded in London back in 2013, All The Fruits is run by illustrator Stephen Cheetham and interior designer Jessica Pinotti in their Bologna based studio. Combining their own creative skills by merging Stephen's bold illustration style with Jessica's passion for interior design, they set out to produce patterns for use in the fashion, textile and home decoration industries. Since starting All The Fruits, they have created a range of own brand products including wallpaper, scarves and cushions, as well as collaborating with a number of international brands.
